documents_expected.why: FY2027 Request for Proposals: eligibility, match, forms, financial documents, reporting
FY2027 schedule: Metro and ECP round deadlines

eligibility.rule: Registered 501(c)(3) nonprofits and government entities; not individuals or for-profits
eligibility.quote: Registered 501 c(3) nonprofit organizations and government entities are eligible for CPL funding. Private individuals and for-profit organizations may not apply.

eligibility.rule: Projects restore, protect or enhance prairies, wetlands, forests or fish, game and wildlife habitat in Minnesota
eligibility.quote: Grants must restore, protect or enhance prairies, wetlands, forests, or habitat for fish, game, or wildlife in Minnesota.

eligibility.rule: FY2027: projects in the 7-county metro area or Duluth, Rochester or St. Cloud only
eligibility.quote: Projects must be located within the 7- county metro area or within city limits of cities with a population of 50,000 or greater (Duluth, Rochester, St. Cloud).

eligibility.rule: Restoration and enhancement only on easement-protected, public land or in public waters
eligibility.quote: Permanently protected by a conservation easement as defined in MN Statutes 84C.01; in public ownership (ownership by a unit of government including tribal, federal, state, county, city, school district, special district, etc.); or in public waters

eligibility.rule: Grants of $5,000 to $500,000 (ECP up to $75,000); total project cost at most $1,000,000
eligibility.quote: Grant requests between $5,000 and $500,000. Total project cost may not exceed $1,000,000.
alt_quotes: Grants are limited to a maximum award of $75,000 (minimum $5,000).

eligibility.rule: Poor performance on earlier DNR grants can mean no or partial funding
eligibility.quote: Applicants who performed poorly on prior grants may not be funded, or may be only partially funded until performance has improved.

eligibility.rule: The Project Manager and the Land Manager must be different people
eligibility.quote: The Land Manager cannot be the same person as the Project Manager.

documents.item: Signed Land Manager Review and Approval Form, with the Natural Heritage review
documents.quote: Applications must include a signed Land Manager Review and Approval Form.

documents.item: Financial documents for nonprofits requesting over $25,000 (statements, Form 990 or audit by income)
documents.quote: Nongovernmental organizations requesting over $25,000 are required to submit financial documentation to meet the State Grant Policy 08-06.
alt_quotes: Financial documentation must be submitted for nongovernmental organizations requesting over $25,000.

documents.item: Public Waters Project Form, for work in public waters
documents.quote: A Public Waters Form is required for projects located in public waters.

documents.item: Letters of commitment from match partners
documents.quote: Match funds from partners must be supported with letters of commitment.

documents.item: Conservation easement documents, for work on private land
documents.quote: For work on private lands, the permanent conservation easement documentation must be uploaded.

documents.item: Engineering design and plans, for construction projects
documents.quote: All plans must be submitted with the application.

effort.step: Submit ECP Round 3 online (first come, first served)
Submit Metro Round 2 online, if funds remain
effort.quote: If funding remains, Round 2 will open on January 1, 2027 and close on February 16, 2027 at 4:00 PM, CST.

effort.step: Map each project site in the online mapping system
effort.quote: Each project site must be mapped using the online mapping system.

effort.step: After award: register as a state vendor and sign the grant contract before work starts
effort.quote: Grantees will need to register with the State Vendor System before they can enter into a grant contract with the State.

co_finance_required.quote: A 10% match of non-state funds is required for all grants. The match may be cash or in-kind resources.

after_award.quote: Accomplishment Reports must be submitted by December 31 of each year that the grant is active.
alt_quotes: A Final Accomplishment Report must be submitted with the final payment request by July 25, 2030.

notes: FY2027 funds go only to Metro projects (7-county metro plus Duluth, Rochester, St. Cloud): no statewide or new-applicant round. Match is 10% of the grant requested (not of project cost). Reimbursement-based, 5% held back until the final report. Metro Round 1 and ECP Rounds 1–2 have passed; Metro Round 2 runs only if more than $1 million remains.
